entries.body:
🤖 Multi-Agent Automated Research & Report Generation
===========================

📚💻

Overview

This repository implements a multi-agent system for automated research and report generation using modern LLM tooling and structured orchestration.

System Architecture

Agents

ResearchAgent
  🛠️ Gathers web content using a Web Search tool (SerpAPI optional) and stores raw snippets with metadata.
AnalysisAgent
  💡 Ingests research results, removes duplicates, ranks relevance, extracts outlines, and produces a structured analytical brief.
ReportWriterAgent
  📜 Converts the structured brief into a formatted Markdown or HTML report and exports it to PDF or DOCX.

Tools

WebSearchTool
  🔍 Abstracts external search APIs. Falls back to a mock provider for offline development.
SummarizationTool
  🔁 Uses Google GenAI to summarize and extract key points from long text

Architecture Flowchart
`mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant ResearchAgent as "Research Agent"
    participant AnalysisAgent as "Analysis Agent"
    participant ReportWriterAgent as "Report Writer Agent"
    participant WebSearchTool as "Web Search Tool"
    participant SummarizationTool as "Summarization Tool"
    
    ResearchAgent->>WebSearchTool: Search web for sources
    WebSearchTool->>ResearchAgent: Return search results
    ResearchAgent->>AnalysisAgent: Pass research results to Analysis Agent
    AnalysisAgent->>SummarizationTool: Use summarization tool on research results
    SummarizationTool->>AnalysisAgent: Return summarized results
    AnalysisAgent->>ReportWriterAgent: Pass summarized results to Report Writer Agent
    ReportWriterAgent->>ReportWriterAgent: Generate report from summarized results
    ReportWriterAgent->>AnalysisAgent: Return final report

Installation and Quick Start
-------------------------

bash
Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/your-username/multi-agent-automated-research-and-report-generation.git

Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

Run the system
python main.py "your research topic"

Usage Examples
-------------------

example
Example usage:
python main.py "impact of climate change on global economies"

Contribution Guide
----------------------

Contributions are welcome! Please follow these guidelines:

Fork the repository
Create a new branch for your changes
Make your changes
Commit your changes with a descriptive commit message
Push your changes to your branch
Open a pull request to the main branch

Roadmap
------------

Future developments include:

Integration with more web search APIs
Support for more summarization tools
Improved report formatting options

FAQs
----

Q: What is the primary language used in this project?
A: The primary language is Python.
Q: What is the purpose of the ResearchAgent?
A: The ResearchAgent gathers web content using a Web Search tool.
Q: How do I contribute to this project?
A: Please follow the Contribution Guide.

Troubleshooting
-------------------

Q: Why am I getting a 404 error when searching the web?
A: Make sure you have the correct SerpAPI API key configured.

Technology Stack
--------------------

Language: Python
Framework: LangChain
API: SerpAPI
Model: Google GenAI
Library: python-docx, weasyprint, reportlab
